findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Crafting resilient web systems & creative tools." → 4 lines (7 words, 72px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 5 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 18 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Ayush Singh" above "Crafting resilient web systems & creativ"; "Ayush Singh Studio" above "&"; "Engineered web platforms design artifacts" above "FEATURED works."; "Frontend Development & UI Design" above "AI CREATOR HUB"; "React" (pill) above "40%"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "↗", "02 Selected Works", "—", "2025–2026 Index"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "/01", "/02", "/03", "/04", "01 / Your Name", "02 / Email Address"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 138 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "02 Selected Works", "—", "2025–2026 Index", "/").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: 🎧
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 42 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.relative.flex → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.absolute.inset-y-1.5 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.group.relative → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 32 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.fixed.inset-x-0 1440px | div.flex.items-center 1312px | div.flex.items-center 691px | div.mt-8.pt-6 555px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 33 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 13 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Advanced" 3.8:1 needs 4.5:1; "Advanced" 3.8:1 needs 4.5:1; "Production" 3.8:1 needs 4.5:1; "Core" 3.8:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 137 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Gambarino and General Sans, but the page renders JetBrains Mono, Plus Jakarta Sans.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is at 0% opacity).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1268px at 10472px; 1056px at 11832px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.
